title: Arithmetic Wavefront Set and Microlocal Structure of Harish-Chandra Character
summary: In this paper, we establish in Theorem 1.2 the reciprocity of wavefront sets for irreducible admissible representations $π$ of classical groups $G$ over any local field $F$ of characteristic zero if $π$ has a generic local $L$-parameter. Over archimedean local fields, based on the progress made in our previous work (arXiv:2207.04700), we prove in Theorem 1.5 that for an irreducible Casselman--Wallach representation $π$ with a generic local $L$-parameter, the Wavefront Set Conjecture (arXiv:2207.04700, Conjecture 1.2) and its refinement (Conjecture 1.1) hold for the arithmetic wavefront set…
